            FACILITY MAINTENANCE AND JANITORIAL SERVICES AGREEMENT

                         Agreement No. LPM-FS-2026-014

This Facility Maintenance and Janitorial Services Agreement (the
"Agreement") is made and entered into as of March 12th, 2026 (the
"Effective Date"), by and among the following parties:

(1) CEDAR POINT MEDICAL PLAZA OWNERS ASSOCIATION, INC., a Minnesota
nonprofit corporation, with its principal office at 4400 Cedar Point
Drive, Eden Prairie, Minnesota 55344 (the "Owner");

(2) BRIGHTWELL FACILITY SERVICES, LLC, a Minnesota limited liability
company, with its principal office at 1185 Industrial Boulevard NE,
Minneapolis, Minnesota 55413 (the "Contractor"); and

(3) LAKESHORE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT GROUP, INC., a Minnesota corporation,
with its principal office at 77 South Ninth Street, Suite 1200,
Minneapolis, Minnesota 55402, acting as managing agent for the Owner (the
"Manager").

The Owner, the Contractor and the Manager are each referred to as a
"Party" and together as the "Parties."

RECITALS

A. The Owner holds title to the common areas of the Cedar Point Medical
Plaza, a three-building medical office complex comprising approximately
186,000 rentable square feet, located at 4400, 4410 and 4420 Cedar Point
Drive, Eden Prairie, Minnesota (the "Premises").

B. Under a management agreement dated January 5, 2024, the Owner has
appointed the Manager to administer service contracts for the Premises.

C. The Contractor is engaged in the business of commercial cleaning,
healthcare-grade janitorial services and light facility maintenance, and
has submitted Proposal No. BFS-P-2611 dated February 6, 2026, which the
Owner accepted following a competitive bidding process.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants set forth below,
the Parties agree as follows:

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES

1.1 The Contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, equipment and
supplies necessary to perform the services described in Exhibit A (the
"Services"), including nightly janitorial cleaning of common areas,
restrooms, elevators, stairwells and lobbies; weekly floor care; monthly
high dusting and window cleaning of interior glass; and quarterly carpet
extraction.

1.2 In areas designated as clinical waiting rooms, the Contractor shall
use EPA-registered hospital-grade disinfectants and follow the cleaning
frequencies and dwell times set out in Exhibit B. The Contractor shall not
enter tenant suites, examination rooms or laboratories unless separately
engaged in writing by the tenant concerned.

1.3 Light maintenance tasks under this Agreement are limited to
replacement of light bulbs and ballasts, restocking of restroom
dispensers, minor touch-up painting, and reporting of plumbing, HVAC or
electrical deficiencies to the Manager within four (4) hours of
discovery. Any repair beyond these tasks requires a written work order
issued by the Manager.

1.4 Snow and ice removal from sidewalks and entrances is excluded from
this Agreement and remains with the Owner's separate grounds contractor.

2. TERM

2.1 The Services shall commence on April 1, 2026 (the "Commencement
Date") and shall continue until March 31, 2028, unless terminated earlier
in accordance with Section 9.

2.2 The Owner may renew this Agreement for one additional term of twelve
(12) months by written notice delivered to the Contractor no later than
December 31, 2027. Pricing for any renewal term shall be adjusted under
Section 3.4.

3. COMPENSATION

3.1 The Owner shall pay the Contractor a fixed monthly fee of Twenty-Two
Thousand Four Hundred Dollars ($22,400.00) for the Services described in
Exhibit A, payable in arrears.

3.2 The Contractor shall submit an itemized invoice to the Manager by the
fifth (5th) day of each month for Services performed in the preceding
month. The Manager shall review and approve each undisputed invoice, and
the Owner shall pay it within thirty (30) days after receipt.

3.3 Additional services requested by work order shall be billed at the
hourly rates set out in Exhibit C ($41.50 per hour for janitorial staff
and $58.00 per hour for maintenance technicians, standard hours). No
additional work shall be paid without a signed work order.

3.4 On each anniversary of the Commencement Date, the monthly fee may be
increased by the percentage change in the Consumer Price Index for All
Urban Consumers (CPI-U), Minneapolis-St. Paul area, over the preceding
twelve months, provided that the increase shall not exceed three and
one-half percent (3.5%) in any year.

3.5 The Manager shall not be personally liable for any payment due under
this Agreement; it acts solely as agent for the Owner.

4. STAFFING AND SUPERVISION

4.1 The Contractor shall assign a dedicated on-site supervisor for no
fewer than forty (40) hours per week, and shall maintain a minimum crew
of nine (9) cleaners on the night shift, Monday through Friday, from 6:00
p.m. to 2:30 a.m.

4.2 All personnel assigned to the Premises shall pass a criminal
background check, complete bloodborne pathogens training in accordance
with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030, and wear Contractor uniforms and photo
identification at all times.

4.3 The Owner, through the Manager, may require the removal of any
Contractor employee from the Premises for reasonable cause.

5. QUALITY CONTROL

5.1 The Manager and the Contractor's supervisor shall conduct a joint
walk-through inspection at least once each month and record the results
on the inspection form in Exhibit D.

5.2 If the average inspection score falls below 85 percent in two
consecutive months, the Contractor shall submit a written corrective
action plan within ten (10) days, and the Owner may withhold five percent
(5%) of the monthly fee until the score returns to 85 percent or above.

5.3 The Contractor shall respond to emergency cleaning requests (spills,
bodily fluids, flooding) within sixty (60) minutes, twenty-four hours a
day, seven days a week.

6. INSURANCE

6.1 The Contractor shall maintain, at its own expense, during the entire
term: (a) commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less
than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 aggregate; (b) workers'
compensation insurance as required by Minnesota law; (c) commercial auto
liability of $1,000,000; and (d) a janitorial services bond (employee
dishonesty) of $250,000.

6.2 The Owner and the Manager shall be named as additional insureds on
the general liability policy. Certificates of insurance shall be
delivered to the Manager before the Commencement Date.

7. INDEMNIFICATION

The Contractor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Owner, the
Manager and their officers, directors and employees from and against any
claims, losses, damages and expenses, including reasonable attorneys'
fees, arising out of the negligent acts or omissions or willful
misconduct of the Contractor or its employees in performing the Services.

8. CONFIDENTIALITY AND PATIENT PRIVACY

The Contractor acknowledges that tenants of the Premises are healthcare
providers subject to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability
Act (HIPAA). The Contractor's personnel shall not read, copy or remove any
document, screen content or record they may encounter, and shall report
any exposed patient information to the Manager immediately.

9. TERMINATION

9.1 Any Party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the
breaching Party fails to cure the breach within thirty (30) days after
written notice describing it.

9.2 The Owner may terminate this Agreement without cause upon ninety
(90) days' prior written notice to the Contractor and the Manager.

9.3 Upon termination, the Contractor shall remove its equipment and
supplies from the Premises within five (5) business days and return all
keys and access cards to the Manager.

10. NOTICES

Notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by certified mail, or
by nationally recognized overnight courier to the addresses stated above,
with a copy by e-mail: to the Owner, attention Board President; to the
Contractor, attention Ms. Renata Okonkwo-Hale, Operations Director; to the
Manager, attention Mr. Gregory Lindqvist, Senior Property Manager.

11. GENERAL PROVISIONS

11.1 This Agreement, including Exhibits A through D, constitutes the
entire agreement among the Parties and supersedes all prior proposals and
understandings.

11.2 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of
Minnesota. Venue for any action shall lie in Hennepin County.

11.3 The Contractor is an independent contractor and nothing herein
creates an employment, partnership or joint venture relationship.

11.4 This Agreement may be amended only by a written instrument signed by
all three Parties. It may be executed in counterparts, each of which
shall be deemed an original.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement on the 12th
day of March, 2026, in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
